text: VideoAgent Product Requirements Attribute Value --- --- Document version v1.6 Updated 2026-11-04 1. Product Goal VideoAgent helps a creator act as the director: describe an idea, select a skill or production setting, generate controllable shots, review the result, and keep finished or in-progress work organized in one workspace. Every primary view is organized around a concrete creation, review, publishing, search, or asset-management task. 2. Target Users - Independent video creators. - Product and brand marketing teams. - Social media operators. - Short-drama and narrative creators. - Users who need controllable video generation across multiple model providers. 3. Navigation Desktop navigation is fixed on the left in this order: Agents Skills Hots Assets Docs The account controls are fixed in the upper-right in this order: Language Notifications Credits Avatar The account-control container has no outer border. Search, language, notifications, credits, and avatar controls use translucent surfaces. Their menus open downward and use the same translucent treatment. The avatar opens login and registration when signed out. When signed in, it shows the account email and a sign-out action. 4. Agents - The home view contains a prominent prompt composer. - The composer supports skill, hook, style, frame, duration, model, quality, audio, and review settings. - The Model selector lists every currently available video model as Provider/Model . - The prompt editor grows downward as wrapped text or line count increases. - Idea prompts are visible only when the prompt is empty; production playbooks remain available for switching. - A user can select a Skill before starting. - Composer setting menus open above or below the trigger based on viewport space and remain inside the visible area. - Production playbooks provide one-click starting points for product ads, creator vlogs, micro drama, music videos, localization, and batch variants. - Applying a playbook fills the prompt and sets its recommended Skill, Hook, style, frame, duration, and review mode. - Selecting the active playbook again cancels it and restores the composer state that existed before the playbook was applied. - Submitting creates a project and enters the project workspace. - The VideoAgent headline and icon stream together. 5. Skills 5.1 Catalogue Skills use one flat catalogue with task-oriented cards. Official skill IDs use: <provider or product /<skill id Kling-native capabilities use the kling namespace. Cross-provider workflows and product-level Skills use video agent . Examples: video agent/search all resources kling/text to video kling/image to video kling/reference to video kling/first last frame kling/motion control kling/video extend kling/video edit video agent/style transfer video agent/video upscale video agent/product film video agent/creator vlog video agent/short drama video agent/review video agent/video localization video agent/batch variants video agent/script assistant video agent/smart preview video agent/camera movement video agent/music video video agent/reference remake video agent/agent handoff Review uses the same skill-card structure as other task-oriented Skills. 5.2 Search and Publishing - Skills has a top search field. - The search field stays pinned to the top while content scrolls. - Search matches user ID, skill ID, title, and description. - A user can publish a skill using the same publish interaction pattern used by Hots. - User-published IDs follow <user id /<skill id . 6. Hots - The top area contains a search field. - The search field stays pinned to the top while content scrolls. - Cards play muted looping video. - Each card shows the title first and author and likes below. - Each scenario card opens Agents with its prompt and corresponding Skill. - Users can publish a post from the feed. Publishing requires an MP4 upload, title, description, and Skill. - Search matches title, author, and prompt. 7. Assets Assets contains the current user's finished and in-progress work. - The top area contains a search field. - The search field stays pinned to the top while content scrolls. - Cards are arranged as a waterfall. - Internal Video and Skill tabs separate the two asset types; cards do not repeat type labels. - Each card shows permission: private or public . - Edit time uses yyyy-mm-dd . - Duration, progress, and summary are not shown. - Video cards play a muted loop on hover and pause when hover ends. Skill cards have no cover image. - Assets displays the current user's real Hots videos and Skills. Every card opens a detail dialog, and video details support playback. 7.1 Project Workspace and Delivery - A project accepts image, video, and audio uploads and shows the reference count. - Uploads must pass content-type, file-signature, and size validation. - Users can inspect estimated credits and explicitly approve generation. - Generated shots can be composed into a film with 16:9, 9:16, and 1:1 deliveries. - Users can reorder shots without replacing Shot IDs, generated assets, or generation history. - Export supports captions, an uploaded soundtrack, an automatic cover, and private or public permission. - Each delivery can be downloaded; share links expire and can be revoked. - Assets lists only uploads, generated clips, deliveries, and community posts available to the current user. 8. Docs Document order: PRD Playbook Arch API Dev Test Ops FAQ TODO English labels and Chinese short labels: English Chinese --- --- PRD 产品 Playbook 玩法 Arch 架构 API 接口 Dev 开发 Test 测试 Ops 运营 FAQ 客服 TODO 待办 Docs requirements: - A search field is available at the top. - The search field stays pinned to the top while content scrolls. - Search covers document text in both languages. - The language control changes only Docs. - The left table of contents supports navigation, highlighting, and collapse. - English and Chinese versions use the same document order. - The Docs area uses a fixed dark theme without a theme toggle. 9. Authentication and Credits - Users authenticate with email and password. - Credentials are stored only as cryptographic hashes. - Sessions use HttpOnly cookies. - The upper-right credit count reflects the current user's VideoAgent balance without exposing the shared Provider account pool. - Generation requires explicit approval before a billable provider call. - Credits are reserved before submission and refunded idempotently after submit, generation, or cancellation failures. 10. Administration - The administration route is /<locale /admin and is restricted to emails in VIDEOAGENT ADMIN EMAILS . - Overview metrics include users, projects, generation jobs, running jobs, failed jobs, and assets. - Administrators can inspect user email, project count, credits, status, and registration time. - Administrators can disable or restore accounts; disabling revokes existing sessions. - Administrators can add or remove credits with a recorded reason. - Administrators can inspect generation jobs and refund failed, cancelled, or uncertain credit holds. - Administrators can create and revoke invite codes and switch registration between open, invite-only, and closed. - Administrators can pause or resume all video generation; both estimation and submission are blocked while paused. - Administrative actions are written to an audit log. - Administrator identity is configured through the environment allowlist, not granted dynamically from the product UI. 11. Non-Functional Requirements - Desktop and mobile layouts must avoid clipped controls. - All primary controls must be keyboard accessible. - Motion supports prefers-reduced-motion . - Search and filtering run in the client. 12. Acceptance Criteria 1. Navigation order is Agents, Skills, Hots, Assets, Docs. 2. Agents can choose a Skill. 3. Skills is one searchable flat catalogue using user id/skill id . 4. Provider-native capabilities use provider namespaces; cross-provider workflows use video agent . 5. Users can publish a Skill. 6. Review appears as a normal Skill card. 7. Hots and Assets both provide top search. 8. Hots cards play video and show title above author and likes. 9. Assets uses internal Video and Skill tabs and shows permission and yyyy-mm-dd edit time. 10. Assets uses a waterfall layout; videos preview on hover and Skill cards have no cover. 11. Docs includes PRD, Playbook, Arch, API, Dev, Test, Ops, FAQ, and TODO in order. 12. Docs search and bilingual switching work. 13. Avatar provides login, registration, or sign-out based on session state. 14. Production playbooks fill the prompt and recommended production settings. 15. Hots scenario cards open Agents with the corresponding Skill selected. 16. The prompt grows with its content and empty-state suggestions disappear while typing. 17. Re-clicking the active playbook cancels selection and restores the previous draft. 18. The Model selector exposes all available video models. 19. Users can upload references, compose a film, download a delivery, and create a share link. 20. User credit reservations, refunds, and Provider-account reconciliation agree. 21. Reordering shots does not delete or recreate existing Shots. 22. Non-administrators cannot access administration APIs or pages. 23. Administrators can manage credits, accounts, invites, and generation state, with every action recorded in the audit log.

text: VideoAgent 产品需求文档 属性 内容 --- --- 文档版本 v1.6 更新日期 2026-11-04 1. 产品目标 VideoAgent 帮助用户以导演身份完成视频创作：描述想法、选择 Skill 或制作设定、 生成可控镜头、评估结果，并在同一工作台中管理成品与半成品。 每个主页面围绕明确的选择、创建、搜索、发布、评估或资产管理任务组织。 2. 目标用户 - 独立视频创作者。 - 产品与品牌营销团队。 - 社交媒体运营人员。 - 短剧和叙事内容创作者。 - 需要跨多个模型服务进行可控视频生成的用户。 3. 导航 桌面端左侧导航顺序固定为： Agents Skills Hots Assets Docs 账户操作固定在右上角，视觉顺序为： 语言 通知 积分 头像 账户操作组不显示外边框。 搜索框、语言、通知、积分和头像使用半透明表面；点击后的菜单向下展开， 并保持半透明。 头像在未登录时提供登录和注册入口，登录后显示账户邮箱和退出操作。 4. Agents - 首页提供醒目的创作输入框。 - 创作框支持 Skill、Hook、风格、画幅、时长、模型、清晰度、音频和审核设定。 - 模型选择器展示全部当前可用的视频模型，格式为 服务商/模型 。 - 输入框随文字行数或自动换行向下扩展。 - 示例灵感仅在输入框为空时显示，创作 Playbook 保持可用并可切换。 - 用户可以在开始创作前选择一个 Skill。 - 创作设定的菜单根据视口剩余空间自动向上或向下展开，并始终限制在可视区域内。 - 创作场景提供产品广告、创作者 Vlog、微短剧、音乐 MV、视频本地化和批量测款的一键起点。 - 选择创作场景后，自动填入提示词，并设置推荐的 Skill、Hook、风格、画幅、时长与审核方式。 - 再次点击当前已选中的 Playbook 可取消选择，并恢复应用该 Playbook 前的创作状态。 - 提交后创建项目并进入项目工作区。 - VideoAgent 主标题和播放键图标同时参与流式输出。 5. Skills 5.1 Skill 目录 Skills 使用统一目录，并以任务型卡片组织。 官方 Skill ID 格式： <provider or product /<skill id Kling 原生能力使用 kling 命名空间；跨 Provider 工作流和产品级 Skill 使用 video agent 。 示例： video agent/search all resources kling/text to video kling/image to video kling/reference to video kling/first last frame kling/motion control kling/video extend kling/video edit video agent/style transfer video agent/video upscale video agent/product film video agent/creator vlog video agent/short drama video agent/review video agent/video localization video agent/batch variants video agent/script assistant video agent/smart preview video agent/camera movement video agent/music video video agent/reference remake video agent/agent handoff Review 使用与其他任务型 Skill 一致的卡片结构。 5.2 搜索与发布 - Skills 顶部提供搜索框。 - 搜索框在页面滚动时固定在顶部。 - 搜索范围包含 user id、skill id、标题和描述。 - 用户可以通过与 Hots 发布一致的方式发布 Skill。 - 用户发布 ID 使用 <user id /<skill id 格式。 6. Hots - 顶部提供搜索框。 - 搜索框在页面滚动时固定在顶部。 - 卡片使用循环播放的视频。 - 标题在上，作者和喜欢数在下。 - 场景卡片可带着对应 Skill 和提示词进入 Agents。 - 用户可以从社区流发布作品；发布必须上传 MP4，并填写标题、描述和 Skill。 - 搜索范围包含标题、作者和 Prompt。 7. Assets Assets 展示当前用户的成品和半成品。 - 顶部提供搜索框。 - 搜索框在页面滚动时固定在顶部。 - 卡片以瀑布流排布。 - 使用 Video 和 Skill 两个内部分页区分类型，不在每张卡片上重复类型标签。 - 必须展示权限： private 或 public 。 - 编辑时间统一使用 yyyy-mm-dd 。 - 不展示时长、进度和摘要。 - Video 卡片悬浮时静音循环播放，移开后暂停并回到开始；Skill 卡片不显示封面。 - Assets 展示当前用户真实发布的 Hots 视频和 Skill；所有卡片可点击打开详情，视频详情可播放。 7.1 项目工作区与交付 - 项目允许上传图片、视频和音频素材，并展示引用数量。 - 上传文件必须通过类型、文件头与大小校验。 - 用户可在生成前查看预计积分并明确批准生成。 - 用户可把已生成镜头合成为成片，选择 16:9、9:16、1:1 交付版本。 - 用户可调整镜头顺序；排序保留 Shot ID、生成资产和生成历史。 - 导出支持字幕、上传音轨、自动封面和私有/公开权限。 - 每个交付版本可下载；分享链接支持过期与撤销。 - Assets 仅展示当前用户可访问的上传、生成、导出和社区发布资产。 8. Docs 文档顺序： PRD Playbook Arch API Dev Test Ops FAQ TODO 中文缩写： 英文 中文 --- --- PRD 产品 Playbook 玩法 Arch 架构 API 接口 Dev 开发 Test 测试 Ops 运营 FAQ 客服 TODO 待办 文档要求： - 顶部提供搜索框。 - 搜索框在页面滚动时固定在顶部。 - 搜索覆盖中英文文档正文。 - 语言按钮切换文档语言。 - 左侧目录支持跳转、高亮和折叠。 - 中英文版本保持相同文档顺序。 - 文档使用统一的深色阅读主题。 9. 认证与积分 - 用户通过邮箱和密码登录。 - 密码仅保存加密哈希。 - 会话使用 HttpOnly Cookie。 - 右上角积分来自当前用户独立的 VideoAgent 余额，不直接暴露共享 Provider 积分池。 - 任何可能计费的生成请求都必须先获得用户明确批准。 - 生成提交前预扣积分；提交失败、生成失败或取消时执行幂等退款。 10. 管理后台 - 管理入口为 /<locale /admin ，仅允许 VIDEOAGENT ADMIN EMAILS 中的邮箱访问。 - 总览展示用户、项目、生成任务、运行任务、失败任务和资产数量。 - 管理员可查看用户、项目数、积分、账号状态和注册时间。 - 管理员可停用或恢复账号；停用后现有 Session 立即失效。 - 管理员可发放或扣减用户积分，并记录操作原因。 - 管理员可查看生成任务；失败、取消和提交不确定任务支持幂等退款。 - 管理员可创建和撤销邀请码，并切换开放注册、邀请注册和关闭注册。 - 管理员可暂停或恢复全部视频生成，暂停后估算与提交均被阻断。 - 管理操作写入审计日志。 - 当前管理员身份由环境变量邮箱白名单配置，不在产品内动态授予管理员角色。 11. 非功能要求 - 桌面端和移动端不得出现控件遮挡。 - 所有核心控件应支持键盘操作。 - 动效支持 prefers-reduced-motion 。 - 搜索和筛选在客户端完成。 12. 验收标准 1. 导航顺序为 Agents、Skills、Hots、Assets、Docs。 2. Agents 可以选择 Skill。 3. Skills 使用统一的可搜索目录，并显示 user id/skill id 。 4. 原厂商能力使用厂商命名空间，跨 Provider 工作流使用 video agent 。 5. 用户可以发布 Skill。 6. Review 使用统一 Skill 卡片。 7. Hots 和 Assets 均提供顶部搜索。 8. Hots 卡片自动播放，标题位于作者与喜欢数上方。 9. Assets 通过 Video/Skill 内部分页区分类型，并展示权限和 yyyy-mm-dd 编辑时间。 10. Assets 使用瀑布流；Video 悬浮预览，Skill 卡片不显示封面。 11. Docs 依次包含 PRD、Playbook、Arch、API、Dev、Test、Ops、FAQ、TODO。 12. Docs 搜索和双语切换可用。 13. 头像根据登录状态提供登录、注册或退出。 14. 创作 Playbook 可填充提示词和推荐制作参数。 15. Hots 场景卡片进入 Agents 时选中对应 Skill。 16. 输入框随内容向下扩展，输入内容后空态建议隐藏。 17. 重复点击已激活的 Playbook 会取消选择，并恢复应用前的草稿。 18. 模型下拉框展示全部可用视频模型。 19. 用户可上传引用素材，完成成片合成、交付下载和分享。 20. 用户积分预扣、退款与 Provider 账户对账一致。 21. 调整镜头顺序不会删除或重建已有 Shot。 22. 非管理员无法访问管理接口或管理页面。 23. 管理员可管理积分、账号、邀请码和生成开关，且操作进入审计日志。

title: Playbook
text: VideoAgent Playbooks Attribute Value --- --- Document version v1.0 Updated 2026-11-04 A Playbook is a reusable production recipe. It combines a business scenario, narrative structure, default production settings, and review policy into an editable project starting point. 1. Common Structure Every Playbook includes: - Scenario name and target user - Business objective and core message - Default Skill, Hook, style, frame, duration, and review mode - Input requirements and optional references - Recommended narrative beats - Output and delivery format - Credit and model-capability constraints - Review and fallback rules 2. Product Ad For launches, proof-led creative, and performance ads. - Hook: proof first - Structure: Hook → use case → proof → hero packshot - Frame: 9:16 - Duration: 10 seconds - Skill: video agent/product film - Review: ask first 3. Creator Vlog For personal stories, lifestyle content, and brand behind-the-scenes. - Hook: visual atmosphere - Structure: context → journey → emotional turn → personal close - Frame: 9:16 - Duration: 10 seconds - Skill: video agent/creator vlog - Review: auto 4. Micro Drama For short-drama scenes, narrative ads, and social cliffhangers. - Hook: narrative twist - Structure: setup → escalation → cliffhanger or reveal - Frame: 9:16 - Duration: 10 seconds - Skill: video agent/short drama - Review: ask first 5. Music Video For music promotion, artist visuals, and rhythmic brand content. - Hook: sound cue - Structure: visual motif → performance → rhythmic escalation → return - Frame: 16:9 - Duration: 10 seconds - Skill: video agent/music video - Review: ask first 6. Localize For adapting existing footage to another market. - Preserve edit, pacing, and product facts - Adapt language, voice, subtitles, and presenter - Skill: video agent/video localization - Review: ask first 7. Batch Test For creative matrices and Hook testing. - Hold product facts and visual identity fixed - Vary Hook, scene, and expression - Produce labeled, comparable variants - Skill: video agent/batch variants - Duration: 5 seconds 8. Operations - Every Playbook references an active Skill. - Defaults stay aligned with composer fields. - Unsupported model capabilities trigger explicit adjustment or fallback. - Version changes update PRD, Arch, and Test.

title: Playbook
text: VideoAgent Playbook 属性 内容 --- --- 文档版本 v1.0 更新日期 2026-11-04 Playbook 是可复用的创作方案。它把业务场景、叙事结构、默认制作参数和审核要求 组合成一个可直接进入创作的项目起点。 1. 通用结构 每个 Playbook 包含： - 场景名称与目标用户 - 业务目标与核心信息 - 默认 Skill、Hook、风格、画幅、时长和审核模式 - 输入要求与可选参考素材 - 推荐叙事节拍 - 输出与交付形式 - 积分和模型能力约束 - 审核标准与降级策略 2. Product Ad 适用于新品发布、卖点验证和效果广告。 默认编排： - Hook：效果实证 - 结构：Hook → 使用场景 → 价值证明 → 产品主视觉 - 画幅：9:16 - 时长：10 秒 - Skill： video agent/product film - 审核：生成前确认 3. Creator Vlog 适用于个人叙事、生活方式和品牌幕后内容。 默认编排： - Hook：视觉氛围 - 结构：进入情境 → 日常推进 → 情绪转折 → 个人收束 - 画幅：9:16 - 时长：10 秒 - Skill： video agent/creator vlog - 审核：自动 4. Micro Drama 适用于短剧片段、剧情广告和社交平台悬念内容。 默认编排： - Hook：叙事反转 - 结构：建立人物 → 激化冲突 → 悬念或反转 - 画幅：9:16 - 时长：10 秒 - Skill： video agent/short drama - 审核：生成前确认 5. Music Video 适用于音乐宣发、艺人视觉和节奏型品牌内容。 默认编排： - Hook：声音开场 - 结构：视觉母题 → 表演 → 节奏升级 → 回到母题 - 画幅：16:9 - 时长：10 秒 - Skill： video agent/music video - 审核：生成前确认 6. Localize 适用于已有成片的跨市场改编。 默认编排： - 保留原剪辑、节奏和产品事实 - 适配语言、声音、字幕和人物形象 - Skill： video agent/video localization - 审核：生成前确认 7. Batch Test 适用于广告素材矩阵和 Hook 测试。 默认编排： - 固定产品事实和视觉识别 - 变化 Hook、场景和表达方式 - 生成带标签的可比较版本 - Skill： video agent/batch variants - 时长：5 秒 8. 运营规则 - Playbook 必须引用有效 Skill。 - 默认参数必须与创作框字段一致。 - 模型能力不足时先降级或要求用户调整，不静默切换。 - 版本变化需要同步 PRD、Arch 和 Test。

text: VideoAgent Software Design Attribute Value --- --- Document version v2.0 Updated 2026-11-04 Backend framework Python + FastAPI Frontend framework Next.js + TypeScript Model Pippit/Seedance 2.5 Draft, Pippit/Seedance 2.5, Pippit/Seedance 2.0 Fast VIP, Pippit/Seedance 2.0 VIP, Pippit/Seedance 2.0 Mini Preview, Pippit/Seedance 2.0 Mini, Pippit/Wan 3.0, Pippit/HappyHorse 1.1, Kling/Kling Video 2.5, Kling/Kling Video 2.6, Kling/Kling Video O1, Kling/Kling Video 3.0, Kling/Kling Video 3.0 Omni, Kling/Kling Video 3.0 Turbo, Kling/Kling Video 4.0, Kling/Kling 2.6 Motion Control, Kling/Kling 3.0 Motion Control, Kling/Kling Image 3.0 Omni, Kling/Kling Image O1, Kling/Kling Image 3.0, Kling/Kling Image 2.1 VideoAgent integrates Pippit CLI and the China-region Kling CLI behind one provider boundary. Pippit provides video submission, task queries, and credits. Kling CLI provides text-to-video, image-to-video, motion control, and multimodal reference tools. 1. Purpose This document describes VideoAgent's product architecture, core modules, directing workflow, data model, API contracts, provider integrations, security, testing, and deployment. 2. Product Overview VideoAgent is a director-oriented AI video workspace. The public navigation contains five isolated views: - Agents: home creation composer and VideoAgent conversations. - Skills: one searchable catalogue of generation, workflow, and review skills. - Assets: a waterfall library of the user's videos and skills with permission and edit time; videos preview on hover and skills have no cover. - Hots: community feed with author, likes, playback, and publishing. - Docs: embedded bilingual documentation with a collapsible table of contents. 3. Scope 3.1 Product Baseline - Left navigation with shared visual and icon behavior. - Home composer with a Skill selector, seven production settings, and custom translucent dropdowns. - Project creation, listing, reading, renaming, and archival. - User ownership isolation. - LangGraph single-node storyboard planning. - Configurable OpenAI-compatible planner with deterministic local fallback. - Storyboard replacement and versioning. - Cost estimation and explicit generation approval. - Pippit CLI text-to-video submission, task polling, and credit query. - Kling China-region CLI text-to-video, motion control, and multimodal reference capabilities. - Mock Provider and Celery polling. - Instant storyboard review for consistency, coverage, clarity, and pacing. - Hots feed playback, author, likes, and publishing. - English and Chinese documentation generated from paired Markdown sources. - Project-level image, video, and audio uploads with MIME, signature, and size validation. - FFmpeg composition with 16:9, 9:16, and 1:1 deliveries, covers, captions, and soundtracks. - Time-limited share links with private/public permissions, expiry, revocation, and access counts. - Per-user VideoAgent credit accounts with reservation and idempotent refunds. - An administration console for users, credits, jobs, invites, launch controls, Provider state, and audit logs. 4. Core User Flow Sign in → describe an idea in the home composer → choose style, frame, length, model, quality, audio, and review mode → create a default project → enter the project workspace → plan a storyboard with VideoAgent → estimate cost and approve generation → poll the generation job → review the storyboard → continue editing or prepare the next generation 5. Current Architecture Browser ├── Next.js product UI │ ├── shared Landing UI │ ├── embedded Docs │ └── project workspace Next.js Route Handler /api/account/ → FastAPI /api/v1 ├── Auth / Projects / Storyboards ├── Agent / Generation / Evaluation / Providers ├── Assets / Delivery / Credits ├── SQLAlchemy Async ├── LangGraph ├── FFmpeg ├── Pippit CLI └── Kling China CLI Celery Worker + Redis → Pippit / Kling task status 6. Technology Stack Area Current technology --- --- Web Next.js 16 App Router, React 19, TypeScript 5.9 UI Tailwind CSS 4, Lucide, shared Landing CSS Localization next-intl routing and translation resources Client state React page state API FastAPI, Uvicorn, Pydantic v2 Agent LangGraph, LangChain OpenAI-compatible provider Database SQLAlchemy 2 Async, SQLite Jobs Celery with Redis Video providers Pippit CLI, Kling China CLI, Mock Provider Media FFmpeg, local filesystem storage Testing pytest, Vitest, Testing Library, Playwright Quality Ruff, mypy, TypeScript 7. Agent Design The directing workflow uses an explicit LangGraph state machine: START → plan storyboard → END plan storyboard receives locale, project title, project brief, and the latest user message. It returns an assistant message and a validated three-shot storyboard. The planner is: - OpenAI-compatible when VIDEOAGENT LLM API KEY and VIDEOAGENT LLM MODEL are configured. - Deterministic and local otherwise. Project, conversation, storyboard, Shot, and GenerationJob state live in the database. Approval, generation, review, and polling boundaries are coordinated through FastAPI, Celery, and the workspace client. 8. Generation and Provider Boundary POST /shots/{id}/estimate → VideoProvider.estimate POST /shots/{id}/generate → require approved=true → require Idempotency-Key → VideoProvider.submit → persist GenerationJob → update Shot → Celery polling GET /jobs/{id} → VideoProvider.status when not terminal → update GenerationJob and Shot The VideoProvider protocol exposes estimate , submit , and status . 8.1 Pippit CLI The service runs pippit-tool-cli through argument arrays and does not use shell string interpolation. Current commands include: status get-credit-balance generate-video query-result The server owns CLI authorization. Provider billing uses the configured server account, while each product user consumes an independent VideoAgent credit balance through /credits . Access keys and CLI session files never reach the browser. 8.2 Kling China CLI Kling uses the server-owned @klingai/cli-cn package and its China-region endpoints. The CLI owns OAuth, MCP transport, and tool validation. The provider adapter maps generationId , task state, errors, and result URLs into the shared VideoProvider contract. VIDEOAGENT KLING EXPECTED USER ID verifies the authorized account. 9. Skills Catalogue Skills use one flat, searchable catalogue. Every card shows its user id/skill id identifier at the upper left. Provider-native capabilities use the provider namespace, such as kling ; cross-provider workflows and product-level Skills use video agent . Skill ID Input and result --- --- video agent/search all resources Search projects, videos, skills, Hots, and Docs kling/text to video Text prompt to one video clip kling/image to video Still image to controlled motion kling/reference to video Image, video, or audio references to a generated clip kling/first last frame Opening and closing frames to a continuous transition kling/motion control Driving-video motion applied to a subject image kling/video extend Continue an existing clip kling/video edit Prompt-directed modification of existing footage video agent/style transfer Apply a reference style while preserving structure and motion video agent/video upscale Raise video resolution up to 4K video agent/product film A composed product-video workflow video agent/creator vlog A composed creator-vlog workflow video agent/short drama A composed short-drama workflow video agent/review Score consistency, coverage, clarity, and pacing video agent/video localization Adapt edit, copy, voice, and presenter details for a target market video agent/batch variants Generate a controlled matrix of hooks, scenes, and messaging variants video agent/script assistant Develop premises into editable scripts with characters, beats, and hooks video agent/smart preview Prepare keyframes and an animatic before final shot generation video agent/camera movement Select and combine purposeful camera moves video agent/music video Plan performance, visual motifs, and beat-synced editing video agent/reference remake Deconstruct a reference and rebuild its structure with new footage video agent/agent handoff Package project context and assets for an external Agent via MCP or CLI Review uses the same task-oriented card structure as other Skills. Selecting a skill preloads a concrete prompt in the Agents composer. The Agents composer also includes a Skill selector. Signed-in users can publish a skill under their own <user id /<skill id namespace. The Model selector uses the verified live catalogue: seven Kling video models and eight Pippit video models, plus Auto. Options use Provider/Model naming so users can distinguish model families. The Agents composer includes production playbooks for product ads, creator vlogs, micro drama, music videos, localization, and batch variants. Selecting a playbook sets the prompt, Skill, Hook, style, frame, duration, and review mode as one coherent starting point. Playbooks use toggle behavior: selecting the active playbook again restores the pre-playbook draft. Hook controls the first-three-second strategy: visual impact, narrative twist, spoken hook, sound cue, or proof first. 10. Data Model Table Purpose --- --- users Account, password hash, and locale preference sessions Hashed server-side session tokens projects Project metadata and owner storyboards One current storyboard per project shots Ordered prompts, duration, frame, mode, and status conversations One conversation per project messages User and assistant messages workspace folders Project folders for conversation organization workspace folder items Conversation-to-folder filing project workflows Concept, outline, script, and generation approval state user skills Published Skill instructions, prompt template, and I/O contracts hots posts Community video publication and metadata generation jobs Provider task, idempotency key, status, result provider connections Provider authorization metadata oauth flows OAuth transaction state credit accounts Per-user VideoAgent balance credit entries Idempotent reservation and refund ledger assets Uploads, generated clips, deliveries, covers, and ownership share links Hashed tokens, expiry, revocation, and access count platform settings Generation switch and registration policy invite codes Hashed invite codes, expiry, and usage limits admin audit logs Administrative action trail 11. API Surface Base path: /api/v1 Area Endpoints --- --- Health GET /health Auth Register, login, logout, current user Projects List, create, read, rename, archive Storyboards GET and PUT /projects/{id}/storyboard Storyboard order PATCH /projects/{id}/storyboard/order Agent Get messages, send a message Workspace Folders, recent conversations, and drag-to-file conversation organization Workflow Read and decide concept, outline, and script approval stages Skills List and persist user Skills; optimize rough ideas into structured drafts Hots Upload MP4 posts, list community videos, and stream public content Evaluation POST /projects/{id}/evaluate Generation Estimate, submit, job status Providers Pippit status and credits Credits GET /credits Assets List, upload, and content download Delivery Export, share, revoke, and public share content Administration Overview, users, credits, jobs, refunds, invites, settings, and audit Agent responses and job status use regular JSON with polling. 12. Frontend Design The shared Landing UI owns: - Left navigation and responsive layout. - Continuous background carousel with no inter-frame gap. - Streaming hero title and blue play brand mark. - Custom transparent composer dropdowns. - Flat searchable Skills catalogue with user publishing. - Hots masonry feed with looping muted video playback. - Searchable Assets waterfall with internal Video/Skill tabs; videos preview on hover and Skill cards omit cover images. - Searchable embedded Docs with a collapsible table of contents. - Semi-transparent search, language, notification, credit, and avatar controls. - Viewport-aware composer menus that flip above the trigger when needed, plus downward-opening language, notification, account, and search menus. - Avatar account actions for login, registration, and sign-out. - An isolated /admin control room for internal operations. - Reference uploads, delivery downloads, cover preview, and share-link creation in the project workspace. - A collapsible conversation history with Projects and Recents, plus drag-to-file organization. - A three-part canvas: current-conversation asset tree, selected asset/document canvas, and approval-driven VideoAgent conversation. - Skill Studio persists reusable Skills with a stable namespace, instructions, quality gates, prompt template, and input/output contracts. AI optimize turns an early idea into that structure. - The built-in video agent/skill synthesis Skill opens Skill Studio directly to help authors compose new Skills. - The app navigation collapses into an icon-only left rail while the remaining content fills the space. Projects and chronological Recents live below the Docs divider, are expanded by default, and remain collapsible. - Conversations use the / conversation/{project id} hash view and only the matching history item is active. - Hots publishing requires an MP4 upload and persists the video as a public asset. The author's Assets view lists real Hots videos and Skills, and every card opens a detail dialog. - Canvas titles use a leading file-type icon without repeating workflow stage; top and VideoAgent headers omit approval status labels. Review shows the overall score directly after evaluation. - Workspace text never renders smaller than button text, and authentication pages use the same dark visual system as the product. - Navigation, project folders, and conversation items share one type scale; dates, counts, and empty-state copy are not rendered. The project workspace progresses through overall direction, episode and shot outline, scene script, and generation-ready states. Each transition requires an explicit user decision. Refinement and custom instructions remain on the current stage. 13. Documentation Language - The globe button beside notifications controls documentation language. - English documents are generated as .html . - Chinese documents are generated as .zh.html . - Document tabs are PRD , Playbook , Arch , API , Dev , Test , Ops , FAQ , and TODO . 14. Security and Reliability - Session cookies are HttpOnly and SameSite=Lax. - Cross-user resources return 404 . - Provider commands use argument arrays and timeouts. - Generation submissions use database idempotency keys. - The database is the source of truth for project, shot, and job state. - Same-origin validation protects cookie-authenticated writes. - Auth, generation, and upload requests use separate rate-limit buckets. - Uploaded media is validated by declared MIME, signature, and size. - Share tokens are stored as hashes and support expiry, revocation, and access accounting. - Administrative APIs require an email in VIDEOAGENT ADMIN EMAILS . - Disabling an account revokes its existing sessions. - Generation checks the runtime kill switch before estimation and submission. 15. Deployment Local development: Next.js :3000 FastAPI :8000 SQLite Pippit CLI or Kling China CLI Celery + Redis 16. Acceptance Baseline 1. Users can create, rename, and archive their own projects. 2. VideoAgent creates a validated multi-shot storyboard. 3. Cost and approval are visible before generation. 4. Jobs and storyboards survive a page refresh or API restart. 5. Provider credentials never reach the browser. 6. Review returns consistency, coverage, clarity, and pacing. 7. Skills is a flat searchable catalogue using user id/skill id , with workflows and Review presented as normal skill cards. 8. Documentation switches between English and Chinese and follows the complete nine-document order. 9. Production playbooks and Skill-backed Hots scenarios provide editable, reusable starting points. 10. The prompt editor grows with stacked or wrapped content, and empty-state suggestions hide as soon as non-whitespace input exists. 11. Playwright uses the Mock Provider to complete registration, creation, upload, generation, export, download, and sharing without paid credits. 12. User credits are reserved before submission and refunded idempotently when submission, generation, or cancellation ends without a usable result. 13. Administrators can manage accounts, credits, invites, and generation state, with every mutation recorded in the audit log.

的产品目标、系统架构、核心模块、Agent 编排、数据模型、接口规范、Pippit CLI 与 Kling 国内版 CLI 集成、安全策略、测试策略及部署方式，供产品、前端、后端、测试和运维研发人员共同参考。 2. 产品概述 VideoAgent 是一个面向内容创作者、营销人员和普通用户的 AI 视频创作平台。产品以“用户是导演”为核心，通过统一的左侧工作台进入 Agents、Skills、Hots、Assets 和 Docs；用户从首页创作框描述创意后创建项目，进入项目工作区与 VideoAgent 协作生成故事板并发起镜头生成。 系统同时提供： - Agents： 首页创作入口和项目内 VideoAgent 对话。 - Skills： 单一可搜索 Skill 目录，使用 user id/skill id 标识，并支持用户发布。 - Hots： 可搜索社区作品流，展示作者、喜欢数并支持发布。 - Assets： 用户成品与半成品作品库，按 Video/Skill 分页；视频悬浮预览，Skill 不显示封面。 - Docs： 九份中英文文档、全文搜索、统一深色阅读主题和左侧可折叠目录。 创作范式结合对话式生成、模板化制作和多模型工作台组织方式。生成能力通过统一 Provider 契约接入，使项目、故事板、镜头和任务状态不依赖单一模型服务。 3. 产品目标与范围 3.1 MVP 目标 - 首页采用左侧导航、连续视频背景、居中创作框、场景 Playbook、Hook 控制和自定义透明下拉控件。 - 创作输入框随内容行数自动向下增高；示例灵感仅在输入为空时显示，Playbook 保持可切换。 - 模型选择器使用实时核验目录：Kling 7 个视频模型、Pippit 8 个视频模型，另有 Auto；选项统一使用 服务商/模型 格式。 - 搜索、语言、通知、积分和头像使用半透明表面，相关菜单向下展开；创作框选项菜单根据视口空间自动向上或向下展开并限制高度；头像支持登录、注册和退出。 - Hots 展示作者与喜欢数，并支持发布。 - 支持项目创建、编辑、恢复和删除。 - 支持 Agent 生成创意方案和多镜头故事板。 - 支持镜头参数编辑和积分成本估算。 - 支持故事板即时评估，计算一致性、覆盖度、提示清晰度和节奏。 - 支持项目级图片、视频和音频素材上传，并校验 MIME、文件头和大小。 - 支持 FFmpeg 合成、16:9/9:16/1:1 交付版本、封面、字幕和音轨。 - 支持限时分享链接、公开/私有权限、过期和撤销。 - 支持用户独立积分账户与预扣、退款流水，隔离共享 Provider 账户的计费风险。 - 支持管理员控制台、用户状态、积分调整、邀请码、生成开关和审计日志。 - 支持服务端统一授权的 Pippit CLI。 - 支持 Pippit 文本生成视频、任务查询和积分余额读取。 - 支持 Kling 国内版 CLI 的文本生成视频、任务查询、动作控制和多模态参考能力。 - 支持 Celery 后台轮询与前端任务状态轮询。 - 保证 Provider Access Key、CLI 登录文件和 MCP 凭据不暴露给浏览器。 4. 用户与核心场景 4.1 目标用户 - 普通内容创作者。 - 电商和产品营销人员。 - 社交媒体运营人员。 - 广告创意和短视频制作人员。 4.2 核心用户流程 登录 → 在首页多设定创作框描述创意 → 提交时自动创建默认项目 → 直接进入项目工作区 → Agent 追问并生成创意方案 → 编辑故事板和镜头 → 查看预计积分 → 确认生成 → 查看生成进度 → 审核并重新生成镜头 → 继续编辑或准备下一轮生成 5. 总体架构 5.1 实现架构 workers.tasks Celery 任务轮询 9. Agent 设计 9.1 基本策略 Agent 使用一个主 Agent 和一个确定性节点，不采用无限制 ReAct 循环，也不将相互耦合的创作职责拆成多个自由对话 Agent。 - LangGraph 负责故事板规划。 - 配置 LLM 时由 LangChain OpenAI-compatible Provider 执行模型调用；未配置时使用本地确定性规划器。 - Pydantic 校验模型输出和工具参数。 - Celery 执行 Provider 任务轮询。 - 项目、对话、故事板和生成任务保存到关系数据库。 Agent 图： START → plan storyboard → END plan storyboard 接收项目标题、Brief、用户消息和 Locale，输出 assistant message 与三镜头故事板，并同步持久化消息和故事板。 10. LangGraph 与 Celery 职责边界： - LangGraph 只生成故事板计划。 - Celery 轮询 Provider 任务。 - 数据库保存项目、故事板、镜头和生成任务的最终状态。 生成流程： 1. LangGraph 或用户操作创建镜头和故事板。 2. 用户批准生成。 3. FastAPI 创建数据库任务和本地幂等键。 4. Provider 适配器提交任务。 5. 保存标准化任务引用。 6. Celery 轮询任务状态。 7. 前端每 5 秒请求 GET /jobs/{job id} 触发状态刷新。 8. 更新 Job、Shot 和 Provider 原始响应。 具备不确定性的提交不能自动重发。提交超时但未获得 Provider Task ID 时，任务进入 submission uncertain ，通过查询账户近期任务进行人工或自动对账。 11. Provider 集成 11.1 Pippit CLI 运维在 API 主机安装 Pippit CLI → 运维执行 pippit-tool-cli login → CLI 将设备凭据保存到操作系统安全存储 → 或 CI 注入 VIDEOAGENT PIPPIT ACCESS KEY → FastAPI 通过受限子进程调用 CLI → 读取 Pippit 账户状态和积分 Pippit 授权由服务端统一持有。Provider 层负责积分读取、生成提交、任务查询和结果标准化。 11.2 Provider 接口 class VideoProvider(Protocol): name: str async def estimate(self, request: GenerationRequest) - CostEstimate: ... async def submit(self, request: GenerationRequest) - ProviderJob: ... async def status(self, job id: str) - ProviderJob: ... 11.3 Pippit 能力 pippit-tool-cli status pippit-tool-cli get-credit-balance pippit-tool-cli generate-video pippit-tool-cli query-result Provider 使用参数数组启动 CLI，不经过 Shell 字符串拼接；stdout 仅接受 JSON，stderr 和完整命令参数不返回到浏览器。 模型与分辨率由服务端环境变量可选配置，留空时使用 CLI 服务的默认值。 11.4 Kling 国内版 CLI Kling 通过 @klingai/cli-cn 的国内站内置 MCP 端点暴露视频能力： - 文本生成视频。 - 图生视频与首尾帧。 - 动作控制。 - Omni-Ref 多模态参考。 - 任务查询和结果 URL 解析。 CLI 负责国内站 OAuth、MCP 传输和工具参数。Provider 适配器将 Kling 的 generationId 、任务状态、错误和结果 URL 映射到与 Pippit 相同的 VideoProvider 契约。 VIDEOAGENT KLING EXPECTED USER ID 用于校验登录账号。 11.5 凭据与进程安全 - CLI 登录文件由操作系统安全存储管理，不写入仓库或数据库。 - VIDEOAGENT PIPPIT ACCESS KEY 仅作为服务端秘密环境变量注入子进程。 - 浏览器、API 响应和日志均不返回 Access Key。 - CLI 命令使用 asyncio.create subprocess exec 的参数数组形式执行。 - 子进程受超时控制；超时后终止进程，不自动重提计费任务。 - Web 进程必须只允许受信用户触发生成，并在调用前执行显式审批。 12. 数据模型 表 关键字段 说明 --- --- --- users id , email , locale , status 用户和语言偏好 sessions id , user id , expires at 服务端会话 projects id , owner id , title , state , brief 视频项目 conversations id , project id 项目对话 messages id , role , content , metadata 对话消息 workspace folders id , owner id , name 历史对话的项目目录 workspace folder items folder id , project id 对话与项目目录的收纳关系 project workflows project id , stage , status 整体设定、大纲、剧本与生成审批状态 user skills owner id , skill id , instructions , input schema , output schema 用户发布的结构化 Skill hots posts owner id , asset id , title , prompt , skill id , like count 社区视频发布及详情 storyboards id , project id , version 每个项目唯一的当前故事板 shots id , storyboard id , index , prompt en , prompt zh , status 镜头定义 provider connections id , user id , provider , encrypted tokens Provider 授权信息 oauth flows id , state hash , provider , expires at OAuth 事务状态 generation jobs id , shot id , idempotency key , provider task id , status 生成任务与 Provider 原始响应 credit accounts user id , balance 用户独立积分余额 credit entries user id , amount , reason , reference id 可审计的预扣与退款流水 assets owner id , project id , shot id , kind , storage key , permission 上传、生成、交付与封面资产 share links asset id , token hash , expires at , revoked at , access count 限时分享与访问计数 platform settings key , value , updated by 生成开关与注册模式 invite codes code hash , max uses , use count , expires at 邀请制注册 admin audit logs admin id , action , target type , target id 管理操作审计 统一使用 UUID 主键、UTC 时间戳和数据库外键。数据库使用通用 JSON 字段保存 Provider 原始响应。 13. 核心状态定义 13.1 项目状态 draft planning awaiting plan approval generating review assembling completed failed archived 13.2 镜头状态 draft ready queued generating completed failed cancelled 13.3 生成任务状态 pending submission uncertain submitted queued running succeeded failed cancelled 14. API 设计 14.1 通用规范 - 基础路径： /api/v1 。 - 认证：HttpOnly 服务端会话 Cookie。 - 成功响应使用 JSON。 - 错误统一返回稳定错误码。 - 项目列表一次性返回。 - 生成写操作要求 Idempotency-Key 请求头。 - OpenAPI 是前后端接口契约。 统一错误响应： { "error": { "code": "GENERATION APPROVAL REQUIRED", "message": "Generation requires explicit approval.", "details": {}, "requestId": "req ..." } } 14.2 主要接口 方法 路径 用途 --- --- --- GET /health API 与数据库健康检查 POST /auth/register 注册 POST /auth/login 登录 POST /auth/logout 退出 GET /auth/me 当前用户 PATCH /auth/me 更新语言偏好 GET/POST /projects 项目列表和创建 GET/PATCH/DELETE /projects/{id} 读取、重命名和归档项目 GET/POST /projects/{id}/messages 读取历史或发送 Agent 消息 GET /workspace 项目目录和最近对话 POST/PATCH/DELETE /workspace/folders 创建、重命名和删除项目目录 PUT /workspace/threads/{id}/folder 收纳或移出历史对话 GET /projects/{id}/workflow 读取逐层审批状态 POST /projects/{id}/workflow/decision 批准、调整或自定义修改当前阶段 GET/POST /skills 读取和保存用户 Skill POST /skills/optimize 使用 AI 将粗略想法整理为结构化 Skill GET/POST /hots 社区列表与视频发布 GET /hots/{id}/video 播放公开社区视频 GET /projects/{id}/storyboard 获取故事板 PUT /projects/{id}/storyboard 整体替换故事板 PATCH /projects/{id}/storyboard/order 调整镜头顺序并保留 Shot ID POST /projects/{id}/evaluate 故事板即时评估 POST /shots/{id}/estimate 积分估算 POST /shots/{id}/generate 创建生成任务 GET /jobs/{id} 查询任务 GET /providers/pippit 服务端 Pippit 状态 GET /providers/pippit/credits Pippit 积分余额 GET /credits 当前用户积分余额 GET/POST /projects/{id}/assets 项目资产列表与上传 GET /assets/{id}/content 读取私有资产 POST /projects/{id}/exports 合成并导出成片 POST /assets/{id}/share 创建限时分享 DELETE /shares/{id} 撤销分享 GET /shares/{token}/content 读取分享资产 GET/PATCH /admin/settings 读取和更新生成、注册策略 GET /admin/overview 管理总览 GET/PATCH /admin/users 、 /admin/users/{id} 用户列表与状态 POST /admin/users/{id}/credits 管理员调整积分 GET /admin/jobs 生成任务列表 POST /admin/jobs/{id}/refund 人工退款 GET/POST /admin/invites 邀请码列表与创建 DELETE /admin/invites/{id} 撤销邀请码 GET /admin/audit 管理审计日志 15. 前端设计 15.1 信息架构 - 公共入口：左侧导航、连续视频背景、居中创作框、灵感快捷项和八项生成设置。 - App 左侧导航可收起为仅图标模式，右侧内容始终填满剩余空间；Docs 下方固定为 Projects 分组和 Recents 时序历史，两个分组默认展开且可折叠，进入对话后保持相同排布。 - 对话使用 / conversation/{project id} hash 内页，不切换到独立的 /projects 页面；只高亮当前对话记录。 - Agents ：首页创作入口和 VideoAgent 对话。 - Skills ：统一可搜索 Skill 目录，卡片显示 user id/skill id ；Kling 原生能力使用 kling ，跨 Provider 工作流使用 video agent ，用户可发布 Skill。 - Skill Studio 将用户 Skill 持久化到数据库；发布前包含用途、执行规范、质量门禁、启动提示词和输入/输出契约，并提供 AI 优化。 - 内置 video agent/skill synthesis 用于帮助用户编写和合成新的 Skill，点击后直接打开 Skill Studio。 - Agents ：首页提供产品广告、创作者 Vlog、微短剧、音乐 MV、视频本地化和批量测款六类 Playbook；选择后统一设置提示词、Skill、Hook、风格、画幅、时长和审核模式，再次点击当前项会恢复应用前草稿。 - Skills 目录还覆盖视频本地化、批量变体、剧本助手、智能预演、运镜设计、音乐 MV、参考复刻和外部 Agent 接力。 - Hots ：可搜索社区瀑布流，视频自动播放，展示标题、作者、喜欢数，并支持发布。 - Hots 发布必须上传 MP4，可填写标题、描述和 Skill；发布视频持久化并出现在作者 Assets。 - Assets ：通过 Video 与 Skill 两个内部分页切换，支持搜索；Video 卡片悬浮静音播放，Skill 卡片不显示封面；卡片只展示权限和 yyyy-mm-dd 编辑时间。 - Assets 展示当前用户真实发布的 Hots 视频和 Skill；点击卡片打开详情，视频详情可直接播放。 - Docs ：按 PRD、Playbook、Arch、API、Dev、Test、Ops、FAQ、TODO 展示中英文文档，支持全文搜索。 - 项目工作区：可压缩历史导航、当前对话资产树、中央资产画布和右侧审批式 Agent 对话。 - 品牌与浏览器标签页图标统一使用蓝色播放键；激活导航图标采用填充/线框反转。 - 管理后台使用独立控制台布局，与用户创作界面隔离。 15.2 项目工作区 桌面端采用四级工作区： 历史导航（Projects / Recents） → 当前对话资产树 → 选中的文档、图片、视频或镜头画布 → 带审批选项的 Agent 对话 移动端采用标签页： History Assets Canvas Agent 历史导航支持压缩，Recent 对话可拖入项目目录，也可拖回全部对话列表。Agent 按“整体设定 → 分集/分镜大纲 → 逐场剧本 → 可生成”推进；每一步都必须由用户 批准，调整与自定义意见不会跳过当前阶段。 中央画布标题前仅展示文件类型图标，不重复标注工作流阶段；顶部和 VideoAgent 标题栏不展示审批状态。 Review 按钮在完成评估后直接显示综合分，不再展示四段进度条。工作区所有文本的最小字号不低于按钮字号。 导航、Projects、Recents、目录和对话 item 使用统一字号；日期、数量和空状态提示不显示。 镜头画布包含： - Prompt 中英文版本。 - 生成模式。 - 宽高比。 - 时长。 - Provider 模型参数。 - 积分估算。 - 生成与错误提示。 - 图片、视频和音频引用素材上传。 - 成片导出、交付版本下载、封面与分享链接。 15.3 前端状态 - 页面使用 React useState 、 useEffect 、页面级 fetch 和定时轮询。 - Agent 消息使用普通 JSON 请求；流式输出使用前端分段动画呈现。 - 项目事件使用轮询。 - 不将 Provider 凭据、Access Key 或敏感任务内容写入 localStorage。 - 私有媒体通过受鉴权的内容路由读取，分享内容通过随机 Token 读取。 16. 国际化策略 产品使用 next-intl 路由、消息资源和后端 locale 字段管理 en 与 zh-CN 。文档提供两套同构内容。 Agent 输出支持三种 Prompt 模式： - 中文说明 + 英文模型 Prompt。 - 全中文。 - 中英双语对照。 后端 API 使用稳定错误码；用户可读文案由前端翻译资源提供。用户语言偏好 仍可通过 PATCH /auth/me 保存。 17. 安全与隐私 - 所有项目、镜头和任务接口均校验用户所有权。 - 会话 Cookie 使用 HttpOnly 与 SameSite=Lax；生产环境必须启用 Secure。 - Pippit CLI 登录文件放在服务账号可访问但受严格权限保护的位置。 - VIDEOAGENT PIPPIT ACCESS KEY 只保存在秘密管理系统或服务环境变量中。 - 不使用 Agent 生成的内容拼接 Shell 命令。 - 日志不记录密码、Cookie、Token、Authorization Header。 - Cookie 写接口校验 Origin 与 Sec-Fetch-Site ，拒绝跨站提交。 - 认证、生成和上传分别执行分钟级限流；分布式部署需将计数迁移到 Redis。 - 上传同时校验声明的 MIME、文件签名和大小。 - 分享链接只保存 Token 哈希，并支持过期、撤销和访问计数。 - 管理接口使用环境变量邮箱白名单授权，普通用户访问返回 403 。 - 停用账号会立即删除其全部 Session。 - 生成开关在 Provider 估算和提交前检查，暂停时不产生外部费用。 18. 可靠性设计 - 数据库任务状态为业务事实来源。 - Celery 负责 Provider 轮询，并对未结束任务按配置重试。 - 生成提交使用数据库幂等键；查询失败可以重试，计费提交禁止盲目重发。 - 前端轮询 GET /jobs/{id} ，数据库是状态事实来源。 - Provider 子进程有超时，超时后终止且不自动重提。 19. 可观测性 后端使用 structlog 记录请求与任务日志。核心字段包括 request id 、 user id 、 project id 、 job id 、 provider 、 duration ms 和 error code 。 20. 测试策略 测试以测试驱动开发为主要工作方式。详细测试范围、测试用例、覆盖目标和质量门禁见 docs/software-test-plan.md 。 整体原则： - 每个业务能力先编写失败测试，再实现最小代码，最后重构。 - CI 仅使用 Mock Provider，不执行真实付费生成。 - 单元测试不依赖 PostgreSQL、Redis、MinIO 或 Pippit 网络。 - 集成测试使用可重复、可清理的真实基础设施。 - Pippit 状态和余额只读 Smoke Test 使用受控服务账户。 - 真实生成测试必须人工触发并显式限制次数和积分预算。 21. 配置项 后端使用 VIDEOAGENT 前缀的环境变量： VIDEOAGENT DATABASE URL VIDEOAGENT SESSION SECRET VIDEOAGENT TOKEN ENCRYPTION KEY VIDEOAGENT VIDEO PROVIDER VIDEOAGENT PIPPIT CLI COMMAND VIDEOAGENT PIPPIT ACCESS KEY VIDEOAGENT PIPPIT VIDEO MODEL VIDEOAGENT PIPPIT VIDEO RESOLUTION VIDEOAGENT CELERY ENABLED VIDEOAGENT CELERY BROKER URL VIDEOAGENT CELERY RESULT BACKEND VIDEOAGENT LLM BASE URL VIDEOAGENT LLM API KEY VIDEOAGENT LLM MODEL VIDEOAGENT MEDIA DIR VIDEOAGENT MAX UPLOAD BYTES VIDEOAGENT FFMPEG COMMAND VIDEOAGENT FFPROBE COMMAND VIDEOAGENT STARTING USER CREDITS VIDEOAGENT AUTH RATE LIMIT PER MINUTE VIDEOAGENT GENERATION RATE LIMIT PER MINUTE VIDEOAGENT UPLOAD RATE LIMIT PER MINUTE NEXT PUBLIC API BASE URL 所有敏感值通过环境变量或密钥管理服务提供，不提交到 Git。 22. 部署设计 本地开发： Next.js :3000 FastAPI :8000 SQLite（默认） Pippit CLI 或 Kling 国内版 CLI Celery + Redis Markdown 文档在构建时生成 HTML，并复制到 public/docs 。 部署流程： 1. 安装锁定依赖。 2. 执行 Ruff、mypy 和测试。 3. 构建前后端镜像。 4. 执行版本化数据库迁移。 5. 滚动更新 API。 6. 更新 Worker。 7. 检查健康和 Provider 状态。 23. 验收标准 1. 用户能够创建、修改、归档和删除自己的项目。 2. Agent 能生成符合 Pydantic Schema 的多镜头故事板。 3. 用户可以在生成前查看并批准预计积分费用。 4. 刷新页面或重启服务后故事板和任务状态不会丢失。 5. Pippit Access Key、CLI 登录文件和 Kling 凭据不出现在浏览器、日志或公开接口中。 6. 生成任务不会因自动重试造成重复扣费。 7. 即时评估返回一致性、覆盖度、清晰度和节奏得分。 8. Hots 的作者、喜欢数、发布入口和预览可用。 9. Mock Provider、Pippit Fake CLI 和 Kling Provider 契约测试全部通过。 10. Playwright 使用 Mock Provider 完成注册、创作、上传、生成、导出、下载和分享。 11. 生成预扣积分，失败或取消时幂等退款。 12. 分享链接可撤销，私有资产不能由其他用户通过内容路由读取。 13. 管理员可管理账号、积分、邀请码和生成状态，所有变更写入审计日志。 24. 主要风险 风险 应对措施 --- --- Pippit CLI 参数或输出变化 命令契约测试、Provider 隔离、版本锁定 生成提交超时导致不确定状态 本地幂等键、任务对账、禁止盲目重试 视频生成耗时长 Celery、持久任务、超时与状态查询 费用误用 审批门、预算上限、积分流水 Token 泄露 服务端加密、日志脱敏、Cookie 安全 前后端类型不一致 OpenAPI 契约测试 Celery 与 LangGraph 状态重复 明确数据库事实来源和单向事件流 中英文内容不同步 统一翻译键、双语测试、Agent Locale 状态

text: VideoAgent API Reference Attribute Value --- --- Document version v1.5 Updated 2026-11-04 Base path /api/v1 Authentication HttpOnly Session Cookie Request format JSON with credentials: "include" API style REST with job polling Billable generation Explicit approval plus Idempotency-Key Write protection Same-origin Origin / Sec-Fetch-Site validation User credits Internal per-user quota with an auditable ledger Administration VIDEOAGENT ADMIN EMAILS allowlist OpenAPI /docs and /openapi.json Base URL: http://localhost:8000/api/v1 Interactive OpenAPI documentation is available at: http://localhost:8000/docs http://localhost:8000/openapi.json All endpoints require authentication except /health , /auth/register , /auth/login , /auth/registration-policy , and /shares/{token}/content . Browser clients must send the session cookie for authenticated endpoints. Authentication The API uses an HttpOnly session cookie named videoagent session . Browser clients must send requests with credentials enabled. Register POST /auth/register { "email": "creator@example.com", "password": "at-least-eight-characters", "locale": "zh-CN", "invite code": "optional-invite-code" } Registration Policy GET /auth/registration-policy Returns open , invite , or closed . Invite mode requires invite code . Login POST /auth/login { "email": "creator@example.com", "password": "at-least-eight-characters" } Current User GET /auth/me Returns the authenticated user's ID, email, locale, and creation time. Update Locale PATCH /auth/me { "locale": "en" } Logout POST /auth/logout Revokes the current session and removes the session cookie. Health GET /health Returns API status and database dependency health. A database failure returns 503 with status: "degraded" . Projects All project endpoints require authentication and are scoped to the current user. Another user's project returns 404 . Method Path Purpose --- --- --- GET /projects List active projects POST /projects Create a project GET /projects/{project id} Read a project PATCH /projects/{project id} Rename a project DELETE /projects/{project id} Archive a project GET /workspace List project folders and all recent conversations POST /workspace/folders Create a project folder PATCH /workspace/folders/{folder id} Rename a project folder DELETE /workspace/folders/{folder id} Delete a folder without deleting conversations PUT /workspace/threads/{project id}/folder File or unfile a conversation Create request: { "title": "Launch film", "brief": "A ten-second cinematic product launch" } Rename request: { "title": "Launch film — final" } Storyboards Read Storyboard GET /projects/{project id}/storyboard Replace Storyboard PUT /projects/{project id}/storyboard { "shots": [ { "description": "Opening product reveal", "prompt en": "Cinematic product reveal with warm rim light", "prompt zh": "暖色轮廓光下的电影感产品亮相", "duration seconds": 5, "aspect ratio": "16:9", "generation mode": "text to video" } ] } Reorder Storyboard PATCH /projects/{project id}/storyboard/order The request must contain every current Shot exactly once. Reordering preserves Shot IDs, generated assets, generation history, and project continuity. { "shot ids": [ "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002", "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001" ] } VideoAgent Conversation List Messages GET /projects/{project id}/messages Send Message POST /projects/{project id}/messages { "content": "Turn the brief into a three-shot launch film" } The response includes the user message, VideoAgent reply, and updated storyboard as JSON. The response also includes the current approval stage. Read Workflow GET /projects/{project id}/workflow The workflow progresses through concept , outline , script , and ready . concept establishes the creative direction, outline defines episodes and shots, and script develops the scene-level production text. Generation is only enabled after the script is approved and the state becomes ready . Submit Workflow Decision POST /projects/{project id}/workflow/decision { "choice": "approve", "instruction": null } choice is approve , refine , or custom . Refinements preserve the current stage. An approval advances one stage and creates the next refinement level. Generation Estimate Cost POST /shots/{shot id}/estimate Generate Shot POST /shots/{shot id}/generate Required header: Idempotency-Key: unique-request-id Request: { "approved": true } Job Status GET /jobs/{job id} Possible statuses include submitted , queued , running , succeeded , failed , and cancelled . Each successful generation reserves the estimated credits from the current user's VideoAgent balance. An immediate submission failure or a later failed or cancelled job returns the reservation through an idempotent refund entry. Credits GET /credits Returns the authenticated user's internal VideoAgent quota. This balance is separate from the server-owned Provider account pool. { "provider": "video agent", "connected": true, "credits": 95 } Skills Method Path Purpose --- --- --- GET /skills List Skills saved by the current user POST /skills Persist a structured Skill POST /skills/optimize Convert a rough capability idea into a structured draft The optimizer returns a stable skill id , title, description, detailed instructions, starter prompt, and input/output JSON schemas. Saved Skills are scoped to the authenticated account and are loaded back into the Skills view. { "idea": "Turn product stills into premium campaign videos", "title": "Editorial product film", "locale": "en" } Hots Method Path Purpose --- --- --- GET /hots List published community videos; mine=true filters to the current user POST /hots Upload an MP4 and publish a community post GET /hots/{post id}/video Stream the public video POST /hots uses multipart/form-data with file , title , prompt , and skill . The uploaded video asset is public and appears in the authenticated author's Assets view. Evaluate Storyboard POST /projects/{project id}/evaluate Returns an immediate review of the current storyboard: { "overall score": 88, "metrics": [ { "key": "consistency", "score": 92 }, { "key": "coverage", "score": 100 }, { "key": "clarity", "score": 84 }, { "key": "pacing", "score": 80 } ], "suggestions": [ { "code": "IMPROVE PROMPTS", "severity": "medium" } ] } Assets and Media Media endpoints are scoped to the authenticated user. Unsupported content types, invalid file signatures, and files above the configured size limit are rejected before an Asset record is created. Method Path Purpose --- --- --- GET /assets List the current user's assets GET /projects/{project id}/assets List assets for one owned project POST /projects/{project id}/assets Upload image, video, or audio media GET /assets/{asset id}/content Download or preview a private asset POST /projects/{project id}/exports Compose and export the current film POST /assets/{asset id}/share Create a time-limited share link DELETE /shares/{share id} Revoke a share link GET /shares/{token}/content Read a valid shared asset without a session Upload request: POST /projects/{project id}/assets Content-Type: multipart/form-data file=<image, video, or audio Export request: { "aspect ratios": ["16:9", "9:16", "1:1"], "soundtrack asset id": null, "captions": "A generated product story", "permission": "private" } The export response contains delivery Assets and a generated cover. The current implementation composes available generated shots with FFmpeg, normalizes each delivery ratio, applies a short crossfade between shots, and optionally includes captions and an uploaded soundtrack. Share request: { "expires in hours": 24 } Share tokens are random, stored as hashes, expire after the requested period, and can be revoked. Access increments an audit counter. Administration Administration endpoints require an authenticated account whose email appears in VIDEOAGENT ADMIN EMAILS . Other users receive 403 ADMIN ACCESS REQUIRED . Method Path Purpose --- --- --- GET /admin/me Confirm administration access GET /admin/overview Counts and launch-state summary GET /admin/users Search users and read credits PATCH /admin/users/{id} Enable or disable an account POST /admin/users/{id}/credits Add or remove credits GET /admin/jobs Inspect generation jobs POST /admin/jobs/{id}/refund Refund a failed or uncertain hold GET/PATCH /admin/settings Read or update generation and registration GET/POST /admin/invites List or create invite codes DELETE /admin/invites/{id} Revoke an invite code GET /admin/audit Read administrative audit entries GET /admin/provider Read the active Provider connection state Settings update: { "generation enabled": false, "registration mode": "invite" } When generation is disabled, estimate and submit endpoints return 503 GENERATION DISABLED . Disabling an account revokes its Sessions immediately. Pippit Provider Method Path Purpose --- --- --- GET /providers/pippit Read server-owned Pippit account status GET /providers/pippit/credits Read the active Pippit credit balance Pippit authorization is server-owned. The API invokes the installed pippit-tool-cli binary; browser clients never receive access keys or CLI session files. Provider billing draws from the configured server account, while product users consume independent VideoAgent balances through /credits . Operators authorize the CLI on the API host before enabling live generation. GET /providers/pippit response: { "provider": "pippit", "connected": true, "scope": "server" } GET /providers/pippit/credits response: { "provider": "pippit", "connected": true, "credits": 42 } If the server CLI is not logged in, the credits endpoint returns connected: false and credits: null . A missing binary returns 503 ; an upstream CLI failure returns 502 . Kling Provider VideoAgent uses the server-owned China-region @klingai/cli-cn package and the https://klingai.com/mcp endpoint. Kling tokens never reach the browser. VIDEOAGENT KLING EXPECTED USER ID pins the authorized domestic account. Operators can use kling who am i and kling account for read-only identity and credit checks. Errors Errors use the following shape: { "error": { "code": "PROJECT NOT FOUND", "message": "The project was not found.", "details": {}, "requestId": "request-id" } } Important status codes: Status Meaning --- --- 401 Authentication required or session expired 402 The user's VideoAgent credit balance is insufficient 403 Approval, administrator, registration, or invite policy denied 404 Resource not found or not owned by the current user 409 Configured provider is not active 413 Uploaded media exceeds the configured limit 422 Request validation failed 429 An auth, generation, or upload rate limit was exceeded 502 Upstream provider request failed 503 Provider CLI is unavailable or generation is paused

Purpose This guide describes the VideoAgent implementation architecture, module boundaries, runtime flow, provider adapters, and engineering conventions. 2. System Scope - Next.js App Router product UI. - Left navigation: Agents, Skills, Hots, Assets, Docs. - Home composer with Skill and Hook selectors, six production playbooks, and transparent custom dropdowns. - Auto-growing prompt textarea with idea suggestions rendered only in the empty state. - Complete live video-model catalogue with provider-labelled Pippit and Kling options. - Flat searchable Skills catalogue using user id/skill id , plus user publishing. - Searchable Hots feed with looping video playback, Skill-backed scenario reuse, and publishing. - Searchable Assets waterfall with internal Video/Skill tabs, permission, and yyyy-mm-dd edit date; videos preview on hover, Skill cards have no cover, and cards do not repeat type labels. - Searchable bilingual Docs with nine documents, a collapsible table of contents, and full-text lookup across languages. - Registration, login, logout, server-side sessions, and user isolation. - Project create, list, read, rename, and archive. - Storyboard read and whole-document replacement. - LangGraph single-node storyboard planning. - OpenAI-compatible and deterministic local planners. - Cost estimate and explicit generation approval. - Pippit CLI, China-region Kling CLI, and Mock Provider adapters. - Celery polling with Redis. - Per-user credit reservations and idempotent refunds. - Image, video, and audio uploads with MIME, signature, and size validation. - FFmpeg composition with landscape, vertical, and square deliveries, captions, soundtrack, and cover generation. - Private asset downloads plus time-limited, revocable share links. - Same-origin write validation and separate auth, generation, and upload limits. - An environment-allowlisted administration console for accounts, credits, jobs, invites, runtime switches, and audit logs. - Instant storyboard review. - CI, security scanning, documentation generation, and release builds. - Playwright and Mock Provider end-to-end acceptance without paid generation. 3. Repository Layout VideoAgent/ ├── apps/ │ ├── web/ │ │ ├── messages/ EN/ZH translation resources │ │ ├── public/docs/ generated English and Chinese Docs │ │ ├── src/app/ Next.js routes and API proxy │ │ ├── src/components/ product UI and project workspace │ │ ├── src/i18n/ next-intl routing │ │ └── tests/ ├── packages/landing/ │ ├── src/index.tsx shared product UI │ ├── src/content.ts English and Chinese content │ └── src/landing.css shared visual system ├── services/api/src/videoagent/ │ ├── agent/ graph and planner │ ├── api/ FastAPI routes │ ├── providers/ Pippit, Kling China CLI, Mock │ ├── services/ storyboard, jobs, evaluation │ └── workers/ ├── docs/ paired Markdown sources ├── scripts/build pages.py Markdown and static Docs builder └── .github/workflows/ 4. Runtime Browser ├── Next.js :3000 │ ├── /api/account/ → FastAPI :8000/api/v1 │ └── /docs/ → generated HTML FastAPI ├── SQLite by default ├── LangGraph ├── Pippit CLI └── Kling China CLI Celery Worker ├── Redis broker └── Pippit query-result The browser account and home creation requests use the Next.js Route Handler. The project workspace uses NEXT PUBLIC API BASE URL . 5. Request Flows 5.1 Authentication register/login → normalize email → hash password with Argon2 → create opaque session token → store SHA-256 token hash → set HttpOnly SameSite cookie 5.2 Storyboards PUT /projects/{project id}/storyboard replaces the complete shot list, increments Storyboard.version , and assigns contiguous shot indexes starting at zero. 5.3 Agent POST /projects/{project id}/messages → persist user message → execute LangGraph plan storyboard → validate StoryboardPlan → replace storyboard → persist assistant message → return both messages and current storyboard 5.4 Generation estimate → POST /shots/{id}/estimate generate → require approved=true → require Idempotency-Key → provider.submit → persist GenerationJob → update Shot → enqueue Celery polling status → GET /jobs/{id} → refresh from Provider when non-terminal 6. Frontend Modules Module Responsibility --- --- packages/landing/src/index.tsx Shared nav, composer, Skills, Hots, Docs packages/landing/src/content.ts English UI and Chinese resources app-landing-page.tsx Product home project creation project-workspace.tsx History navigation, asset tree, canvas, approval-driven Agent chat, generation, and review lib/api.ts Host-aware API URL resolution for localhost and 127.0.0.1 development scripts/build pages.py bilingual Docs build Assets is the unified index for projects and generated media. A project detail route opens its workspace. The product app opens conversations at / conversation/{project id} while the standalone project route remains for compatibility. 8. Skills Implementation Skills is one flat searchable catalogue. Cards show user id/skill id and preload actionable prompts into the Agents composer. Provider-native capabilities use the provider namespace, while cross-provider workflows use video agent : video agent/search all resources kling/text to video kling/image to video kling/reference to video kling/first last frame kling/motion control kling/video extend kling/video edit video agent/style transfer video agent/video upscale video agent/product film video agent/creator vlog video agent/short drama video agent/review video agent/video localization video agent/batch variants video agent/script assistant video agent/smart preview video agent/camera movement video agent/music video video agent/reference remake video agent/agent handoff Review uses the same card form as other task-oriented Skills. Applying one updates the full composer draft; clicking the active playbook again restores the saved pre-playbook composer state. Hots cards carry a Skill ID so scenario reuse enters Agents with the matching Skill selected. 9. Documentation Localization The globe control switches documentation language. English: product-requirements.html Chinese: product-requirements.zh.html The same pattern applies to all nine documents in this order: PRD, Playbook, Arch, API, Dev, Test, Ops, FAQ, and TODO. Docs search uses docs-search.json across both languages. Docs language follows application locale state. 10. Security - Argon2 password hashing. - Opaque session tokens with SHA-256 storage. - HttpOnly and SameSite=Lax cookies. - Ownership checks on projects, shots, and jobs. - Pippit credentials remain server-side. - Kling OAuth state remains inside the MCP connector boundary. - CLI calls use argument arrays and timeouts. - Secret and dependency scanning run in CI. - Unsafe methods validate Origin and Sec-Fetch-Site . - Uploads enforce byte limits and validate declared MIME plus file signatures. - Share tokens are stored as hashes and become unavailable after expiry or revocation. - Administration access is restricted by VIDEOAGENT ADMIN EMAILS . - Disabling a user immediately revokes existing sessions. - The generation kill switch blocks both estimation and Provider submission. 13. 。 - 所有外部输入由 Pydantic 校验。 - API 错误使用稳定错误码。 - 不能把 Pippit Access Key 或 CLI 登录文件写入日志。 - 新查询必须包含用户所有权条件。 16.2 Agent - LLM 输出必须使用 Pydantic 结构化模型。 - 不在 Agent 中直接执行删除、支付或账号操作。 - 外部生成操作必须经过明确的计费审批。 - Prompt Query 或页面级异步加载。 - 临时交互状态使用 React state/Zustand。 - 新文案必须同时进入 en.json 和 zh-CN.json 。 - 优先使用语义标签和可访问控件。 - 动效必须支持 prefers-reduced-motion 。 - Pippit 凭据不得进入 localStorage 或浏览器状态。 17. 扩展点 新增视频 Provider 1. 实现 VideoProvider 。 2. 将 Provider 错误映射为领域错误。 3. 增加 Provider Contract 测试。 4. 在 Provider Resolver 中增加选择逻辑。 5. 增加前端能力展示和积分字段。 新增 Agent 节点 1. 在 AgentState 中增加类型化状态。 2. 为该状态迁移编写单元测试。 3. 将节点加入 StateGraph 。 4. 保持节点幂等。 5. 涉及外部长任务时交给 Celery，不在图节点内阻塞等待。 新增 API 1. 在 schemas.py 增加输入输出模型。 2. 在 services/ 增加业务逻辑。 3. 在 api/ 增加薄路由。 4. 增加所有权和未授权测试。 5. 更新本文档和 OpenAPI 调用方。 19. 提交流程检查清单 - 功能有对应失败测试和通过测试。 - 新接口包含鉴权与资源所有权校验。 - 新文案中英文 Key 一致。 - 没有提交 .env 、Token、上传媒体或本地数据库。 - Ruff、mypy、pytest、TypeScript、Vitest 和 Next Build 通过。 - 新增外部依赖已写入锁文件。 - 新增配置已写入 .env.example 。 - 设计或实现边界变化已更新本文档。

text: VideoAgent Testing and TDD Attribute Value --- --- Document version v2.4 Updated 2026-11-04 Frameworks pytest, Vitest, Testing Library, Playwright 1. Purpose This document defines the automated test strategy, contracts, quality gates, and acceptance checks for the VideoAgent system. 2. TDD Rules 1. Add one failing behavior test. 2. Implement the smallest change that passes. 3. Refactor without changing public behavior. 4. Run all relevant quality gates before commit. Tests assert public behavior, API contracts, ownership, state transitions, and user-visible outcomes rather than private implementation details. 3. Test Layers Unit and component tests → Provider and API contract tests → SQLite integration tests → Playwright and Mock Provider browser E2E External paid generation is never part of normal CI. 4. Coverage Backend: - Password hashing and session behavior. - Project ownership, rename, and archive. - Storyboard replacement and versioning. - Agent planning with deterministic and fake LLM behavior. - Mock, Pippit, and Kling Provider contracts. - Estimate, approval, idempotency, and job status. - Provider status and credits. - Health endpoint. - Instant storyboard evaluation. - Media MIME, signature, size, and ownership validation. - FFmpeg composition, delivery, cover generation, sharing, expiry, and revocation. - User credit reservation, failure refunds, and idempotent ledger entries. - Same-origin write validation and authentication rate limiting. - Administrator email allowlists and non-admin denial. - User disablement, session revocation, and credit adjustment. - Invite creation, consumption, revocation, and registration modes. - Generation kill switch, job refunds, and audit logs. - China-region Kling CLI submission, status mapping, identity, and credits. Frontend: - Shared landing structure and navigation. - Sequenced and looping hero headline. - Search composer and custom settings dropdowns. - Project creation flow. - Assets, Hots, and Docs view switching. - Assets permission, date, hover preview, and cover behavior. - Hots author, likes, playback, and publishing. - English-to-Chinese Docs switching. - Project list, authentication form, and project workspace. - Project uploads, film export, MP4 download, and share-link creation. - Administration console loading, settings changes, and denied access. 5. Provider Contract Tests Every VideoProvider verifies: - Provider name is stable. - Estimate returns normalized credits and duration. - Submit returns a stable task reference. - Status maps to pending , submitted , queued , running , succeeded , failed , or cancelled . - Errors do not expose credentials or full sensitive command arguments. - The same idempotency key does not submit twice. Pippit tests use a local fake CLI and cover status, credits, submit, query, timeout, missing binary, invalid JSON, and missing task IDs. Kling tests use a fake MCP client and cover text-to-video, image-to-video, motion control, task-state mapping, and result extraction. 6. API Tests Required assertions: - Authentication and ownership. - Response status and schema. - Stable error codes. - Explicit generation approval. - Idempotency behavior. - Storyboard replacement ordering. - Shot IDs, generated assets, and history remain intact after reordering. - Agent message persistence. - Evaluation result shape. - No provider credentials in responses. 7. Frontend Tests Component tests cover: - Left navigation with isolated views. - Custom dropdown rendering and selection. - Action button enabled and disabled states. - Hots metadata order: title above author and likes. - Every Hots card contains an autoplaying muted looping video. - Publish entry uses the blue play icon. - Skills is one searchable catalogue with user id/skill id labels; provider-native capabilities use the provider namespace. - Production playbooks fill the prompt and recommended Skill, Hook, style, frame, duration, and review settings. - Re-clicking the active playbook restores the prior composer state. - Hots scenario cards open Agents with the corresponding Skill and prompt. - The textarea grows with multiline content, and idea suggestions disappear while the prompt contains non-whitespace text. - The Model selector includes every available Kling and Pippit video model in Provider/Model format. - Docs labels are PRD , Playbook , Arch , API , Dev , Test , Ops , FAQ , and TODO . - Globe control changes Docs source and language. - Skills, Hots, Assets, and Docs search controls stay pinned while content scrolls. - Assets switches between Video and Skill tabs without repeating type labels. - Video assets preview on hover; Skill assets have no cover. - Composer menus stay inside the viewport. - Conversation history shows Projects and Recents; folders support creation, rename, deletion, and drag-to-file organization. - Stage approval options cover overall direction, episode and shot outline, and scene script; custom instructions keep the current stage. - Shot estimation and generation remain disabled until the script is approved. - Skill Studio captures purpose, instructions, quality gates, starter prompt, and input/output contracts. - AI optimization converts a rough idea into a structured draft, and saved Skills reload from the server. - video agent/skill synthesis opens Skill Studio directly. - The app navigation collapses to an icon-only rail, and signed-in Agents views list recent conversations. - Hots publishing requires an MP4 and the post appears in the author's Assets. - Assets video and Skill cards open detail dialogs, with video playback. - Workflow approvals advance immediately, and Agent language follows the project brief and user prompt. - Login and registration use the same dark visual language as the product. - Pippit normalizes sub-four-second requests and surfaces provider failures while refunding reserved credits. - Search, language, notifications, credits, and avatar controls use translucent surfaces. - Avatar opens login and registration when signed out and sign-out when signed in. - API starts with its metadata table. - FAQ and TODO have paired English and Chinese documents. Playwright uses the real Next.js UI, FastAPI service, SQLite, and Mock Provider to verify: register → home prompt → create project → three approvals → select shot → upload → estimate → generate → poll/materialize → export → download → share An additional no-fee Skill flow verifies: register → Skills → rough idea → AI optimize → publish → reload The no-fee Hots and Assets flow is: register → Hots → upload MP4 → publish → Assets → open details and play This flow never calls a paid Provider and is a required Pull Request gate. The administration E2E covers administrator sign-in, console loading, and generation pause. Backend integration tests cover non-admin 403 responses, credit adjustments, account disablement, invite registration, and audit logs. 8. Responsive and Accessibility Checks - Keyboard access for navigation, dropdowns, Docs, and dialogs. - Visible focus states. - Sufficient text size and contrast. - Reduced-motion support. - Desktop sidebar and mobile navigation remain usable. - Long English and Chinese text do not overlap. 9. CI Gates Pull requests must pass: Ruff check and formatting mypy strict checks pytest Vitest TypeScript check Next.js production build Docs and static artifact build Playwright with Mock Provider E2E secret and dependency scans 10. Provider Verification Read-only 1. Install and authenticate pippit-tool-cli . 2. Run status and get-credit-balance . 3. Query /providers/pippit and /providers/pippit/credits . 4. Verify logs omit access keys. 5. Verify China-region Kling CLI who am i confirms authorization, account region, and model discovery. Authorized paid generation Only with explicit user approval and budget: 1. Record starting credits. 2. Submit one minimal task. 3. Verify the idempotency key and Provider task reference. 4. Poll to completion. 5. Record result, credits, and UI/API consistency. 6. Do not automatically retry an uncertain submission. 11. Definition of Done - Tests were written before implementation or alongside a documented regression case. - Relevant local tests pass. - Ruff, mypy, TypeScript, Next build, and Docs build pass. - No secrets, local databases, or generated media are committed. - API and UI documentation are updated when behavior changes. - Paid Provider tests remain opt-in.

text: VideoAgent 软件测试与 TDD 规范 属性 内容 --- --- 文档版本 v2.4 更新日期 2026-11-04 测试框架 pytest、Vitest、Testing Library、Playwright 1. 目的 本文档定义 VideoAgent 的自动化测试策略、契约、质量门禁与验收检查。 2. TDD 规则 1. 先编写一个失败的行为测试。 2. 编写足以通过测试的最小实现。 3. 在不改变公开行为的前提下重构。 4. 提交前执行完整质量门禁。 测试关注公开行为、API 契约、权限、状态迁移和用户可见结果，不绑定私有实现细节。 3. 测试分层 单元与组件测试 → Provider 与 API 契约测试 → SQLite 集成测试 → Playwright + Mock Provider 浏览器 E2E 真实付费生成不进入普通 CI。 4. 覆盖范围 后端： - 密码哈希与会话行为。 - 项目所有权、重命名和归档。 - 故事板替换与版本。 - 确定性 Planner 与 Fake LLM 的 Agent 规划。 - Mock、Pippit 和 Kling Provider 契约。 - 积分估算、审批、幂等和任务状态。 - Provider 状态与积分。 - 健康检查。 - 故事板即时评估。 - 媒体 MIME、文件头、大小校验和用户所有权。 - FFmpeg 合成、导出、封面生成、分享、过期和撤销。 - 用户积分预扣、失败退款与幂等流水。 - 同源写请求校验及认证限流。 - 管理员邮箱白名单与普通用户拒绝访问。 - 用户停用、Session 撤销和积分调整。 - 邀请码创建、消费、撤销和注册模式。 - 生成 kill switch、任务退款和审计日志。 - 国内版 Kling CLI 的提交参数、状态映射、账号身份和积分读取。 前端： - 共享 Landing 结构与导航。 - 流式主标题和视频轮播。 - 创作框与自定义下拉。 - 项目创建流程。 - Assets、Hots 和 Docs 视图切换。 - Assets 权限、日期、悬浮预览与封面行为。 - Hots 作者、喜欢数、播放和发布。 - Docs 中英文切换。 - 项目列表、认证表单与项目工作区。 - 项目素材上传、成片导出、MP4 下载和分享链接。 - 管理控制台加载、设置切换和权限拒绝页面。 5. Provider 契约测试 每个 VideoProvider 验证： - Provider 名称稳定。 - 积分估算返回标准化积分与时长。 - 提交返回稳定任务引用。 - 状态映射为 pending 、 submitted 、 queued 、 running 、 succeeded 、 failed 或 cancelled 。 - 错误不暴露凭据或完整敏感命令参数。 - 相同幂等键不会重复提交。 Pippit 测试使用本地 Fake CLI，覆盖状态、积分、提交、查询、超时、缺失二进制、 无效 JSON 和缺失任务 ID。Kling 测试使用 Fake MCP Client，覆盖文生视频、 图生视频、动作控制、任务状态映射和结果提取。 Kling 国内版另使用依赖注入测试覆盖 text to video 、 query tasks 、 who am i 和 account ，测试不实际提交生成任务。 6. API 测试 必须验证： - 认证与所有权。 - 响应状态码和 Schema。 - 稳定错误码。 - 显式生成审批。 - 幂等行为。 - 故事板替换后的镜头顺序。 - 镜头排序后 Shot ID、生成资产和历史保持不变。 - Agent 消息持久化。 - 评估结果结构。 - 响应不包含 Provider 凭据。 7. 前端测试 组件测试覆盖： - 左侧独立视图导航。 - 自定义下拉渲染与选择。 - Action 启用和禁用状态。 - Hots 元数据顺序：标题在作者与喜欢数之上。 - 每张 Hots 卡片包含自动播放、静音、循环视频。 - 发布入口使用蓝色播放键。 - Skills 使用 user id/skill id 的单一搜索目录，原厂商能力使用厂商命名空间。 - Playbook 正确填充提示词、Skill、Hook、风格、画幅、时长和审核设置。 - 再次点击当前 Playbook 会恢复应用前状态。 - Hots 场景卡片进入 Agents 时选中对应 Skill 和提示词。 - 输入框随多行内容增高，输入非空时隐藏示例灵感。 - Model 目录包含全部 Kling 与 Pippit 视频模型，并显示为 服务商/模型 。 - Docs 标签为 PRD 、 Playbook 、 Arch 、 API 、 Dev 、 Test 、 Ops 、 FAQ 、 TODO 。 - Globe 控件切换 Docs 语言。 - Skills、Hots、Assets、Docs 搜索框保持固定。 - Assets 通过 Video/Skill 分页切换，不重复类型标签。 - Video 悬浮预览，Skill 卡片无封面。 - 创作框菜单不超出视口。 - 历史导航展示 Projects 与 Recents，项目目录支持创建、重命名、删除和拖拽收纳。 - Agent 逐层展示整体设定、分集/分镜大纲和逐场剧本审批选项，自定义意见保持当前阶段。 - 只有剧本批准后才允许估算和生成镜头。 - Skill 发布表单包含用途、执行规范、质量门禁、启动提示词和输入输出契约。 - AI 优化按钮能把粗略想法整理为结构化 Skill，保存后从服务端恢复。 - 内置 video agent/skill synthesis 直接打开 Skill Studio。 - App 左侧导航可收起为仅图标，登录后 Agents 首页显示最近对话。 - Hots 发布必须选择 MP4，上传成功后出现在社区和作者 Assets。 - Assets 的视频与 Skill 卡片可点击打开详情，视频详情可播放。 - 工作流批准立即推进；Agent 回复语言跟随项目 Brief 和用户 Prompt。 - 登录、注册与主产品使用一致的深色视觉语言。 - Pippit 低于 4 秒的请求会被规范化，Provider 拒绝会显示原始失败原因并返还预留积分。 - 搜索、语言、通知、积分和头像使用半透明表面。 - 头像在未登录时提供登录与注册，登录后提供退出。 - API 文档开头展示属性表。 - FAQ 与 TODO 均有中英文版本。 Playwright 使用真实 Next.js 页面、FastAPI、SQLite 和 Mock Provider，验证： 注册 → 首页创意 → 创建项目 → 三轮审批 → 选择镜头 → 上传素材 → 积分估算 → 生成 → 轮询/落地 → 合成导出 → 下载 → 分享 另有一条无费用 Skill 链路： 注册 → Skills → 输入粗略想法 → AI 优化 → 发布 → 刷新后恢复 无费用 Hots / Assets 链路： 注册 → Hots → 上传 MP4 → 发布 → Assets → 查看详情并播放 该链路不调用真实付费 Provider，应作为每个 Pull Request 的必过门禁。 管理后台 E2E 验证管理员登录、控制台加载和暂停生成；后端集成测试验证普通用户 返回 403 、积分调整、账号停用、邀请码注册和审计日志。 8. 响应式与可访问性 - 导航、下拉、Docs 和弹窗可用键盘操作。 - 工作区最小字号不低于按钮字号。 - 焦点样式清晰。 - 字号和对比度充足。 - 支持 prefers-reduced-motion 。 - 桌面侧栏和移动导航可用。 - 中英文长文本不重叠。 9. CI 门禁 Pull Request 必须通过： Ruff 检查与格式检查 mypy 严格类型检查 pytest Vitest TypeScript 检查 Next.js 生产构建 Docs 与静态产物构建 Playwright + Mock Provider E2E 敏感信息和依赖扫描 10. Provider 验证 只读检查 1. 安装并认证 pippit-tool-cli 。 2. 执行 status 与 get-credit-balance 。 3. 查询 /providers/pippit 和 /providers/pippit/credits 。 4. 验证日志不包含 Access Key。 5. 使用 Kling 国内版 CLI who am i 验证授权、账号区域和模型发现。 获准的付费生成 仅在用户明确批准预算时： 1. 记录起始积分。 2. 提交一个最小任务。 3. 验证幂等键和 Provider Task Reference。 4. 轮询到完成。 5. 记录结果、积分和 UI/API 状态一致性。 6. 不确定提交禁止自动重试。 11. 完成定义 - 测试先于实现，或与已记录的回归用例同步编写。 - 相关本地测试通过。 - Ruff、mypy、TypeScript、Next Build 和 Docs Build 通过。 - 不提交密钥、本地数据库或生成媒体。 - 行为变化同步更新 API 与 UI 文档。 - 付费 Provider 测试保持人工开启。
